features.label: A translator, not an originator
features.detail: Made Eastern thought legible to the West. That is the value, and he said so himself.

features.label: Did not practise it
features.detail: Drank heavily and was candid about not being a model. Take the ideas and leave the life.

features.label: Entertaining is the risk
features.detail: So listenable that hearing him can quietly substitute for doing anything at all.
